svg.text: Five native DDR power links replace blind pad barrels
Actual native geometry · fixed processor, memory and decoupling placement · 0.2 mm copper links
Green: new surface copper · Blue: existing through DDR_1V5 barrel · Orange: removed partial-span pad barrel
All 686 native entries, 257 exported net groups and 416 post-drill Ground terminals remain connected.
Original route bodies preserved. Added power-link length: 0.800–2.945 mm. SI/PI, timing and current capacity are unqualified. Mixed spans remain.
